title: OpenCampus · UO Eugene
description: Explore a geospatial whitebox of the University of Oregon main Eugene campus.
source_description: Oregon DOGAMI / NOAA Digital Coast. Historical survey: 2008-08-31. Nine source tiles cover the main campus and surrounding context.
about_summary: Grey ground is interpolated from classified ground returns. Most white structures are historical LiDAR-derived candidates and may include canopy, split roofs or missed buildings.
about_limitations: Names use public building facts and independently curated approximate locators. Name-to-roof matches still need site verification. Post-survey or unextracted buildings use explicitly approximate envelopes, not measured reconstructions. The scene includes surrounding context; its square extent is not an official property boundary.
project_description: Open Campus: UO develops this campus model and viewer. Its public upstream pipeline develops reusable reconstruction methods, automation and the browser template. Additional maps can build on the same template.
footer: Independent reconstruction project. No University of Oregon endorsement. Public development preview.
